title: KawoDeda
description: Changes the enchanted table's language characters to "Ы".
body: This resource pack replaces all floating magical glyphs around the Enchanting Table with a single, iconic character: the Cyrillic letter "Ы". This creates a unique and humorous visual overhaul for the enchanting interface. The concept is a direct reference to content from the channel KawoDeda, where a similar "Ы" font was famously used as mysterious background hieroglyphs. This pack brings that recognizable joke directly into Minecraft, capturing the spirit of the original. By installing it, you'll transform the standard enchanting animation into a fun and memorable reference, without altering any game mechanics or enchantment probabilities.
